newsitem.title: CHINA: China H1 industrial tax collection up 19.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: China H1 industrial tax collection up 19.5 percent.

text.p: China collected 357.98 billion yuan ($43.1 billion) in industrial and commercial taxes in the first six months of 1997, up a year-on-year 19.5 percent, the Legal Daily said on Saturday.
Of the total taxes, the central government collected 198.12 billion yuan, up 20.8 percent year-on-year, it said. Local governments collected 159.87 billion yuan, up by 17.9 percent.
Collection had met 51.5 percent of the year's targets, it said.
China's collection of value-added taxes and consumption taxes were 192.26 billion yuan in the period, a year-on-year rise of 13.3 percent, it said but gave no further details.
